title: iHRIS 4.3.3 code list: step_type
description: The `step_type` code list as iHRIS 4.3.3 ships it by default: 2 codes from ihris-common/module/mHero-base. Each term's notation is the iHRIS record id and its label the record's `name`. The source gives no definitions, so every term is a candidate.
